sum: Iron Dome Acquisition I Corp. does not have significant operations. The company focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. It intends to target businesses in the cybersecurity, defense technology, artificial intelligence, data infrastructure, and quantum computing domains. Iron Dome Acquisition I Corp. was incorporated in 2025 and is based in New York, New York.
ceo: Mr. Tom Yacov Livne (Founder, CEO & Director)
